sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: We've got some breaking news out of Iran.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了一些来自伊朗的突发新闻。

sentences.en: We are hearing for the first time from the new supreme leader of Iran.
sentences.zh: 我们第一次听到了伊朗新任最高领袖的声音。

sentences.en: Today's statement dismissed any hope of Iran backing down.
sentences.zh: 今天的声明打消了伊朗做出让步的任何希望。

sentences.en: He says, quote,
sentences.zh: 他说，引用如下：

sentences.en: At the heart of the Iranian regime's defiant stance toward the United States and Israel in this war is its new supreme leader, Mushtaba Khamenei,
sentences.zh: 在这场战争中，伊朗政权对美国和以色列采取强硬立场的核心，是其新任最高领袖穆什塔巴·哈梅内伊，

sentences.en: the son of the regime's longtime ruler.
sentences.zh: 他是该政权长期统治者的儿子。

sentences.en: He said that all U.S.
sentences.zh: 他说，所有美国

sentences.en: bases should immediately be closed in the region.
sentences.zh: 在这一地区的基地都应立即关闭。

sentences.en: And he says that those bases will be attacked.
sentences.zh: 他还说，这些基地将遭到攻击。

sentences.en: He went on to say that the Strait of Hormuz should remain closed.
sentences.zh: 他接着说，霍尔木兹海峡应该保持关闭。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Farnaz Fasehi on the extraordinary behind-the-scenes jockeying that led to his selection and the growing consensus that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事法尔纳兹·法塞希将讲述导致他当选的非凡幕后博弈，以及美国

sentences.en: and Israeli strategy motivated Iran to replace one hard-line leader with another.
sentences.zh: 和以色列的战略促使伊朗用一位强硬派领袖取代另一位强硬派领袖的日益增长的共识。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, March 17th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月17日，星期二。

sentences.en: Farnaz, welcome back to the show.
sentences.zh: 法尔纳兹，欢迎回到节目。

sentences.en: I just want to say at the outset that there are moments when our colleagues, because of their area of expertise, just become indispensable to The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我首先想说，有时我们的同事因为他们的专业领域，对《每日新闻》来说变得不可或缺。

sentences.en: And you're one of those people now because you know Iran and its government inside and out.
sentences.zh: 你现在就是其中之一，因为你对伊朗及其政府了如指掌。

sentences.en: So thank you for making time for us.
sentences.zh: 所以感谢你抽出时间接受我们的采访。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Your latest line of reporting has been focused on Iran's new supreme leader,
sentences.zh: 你最近的报道重点关注了伊朗的新任最高领袖，

sentences.en: Mushtaba Khamenei, the son of the assassinated supreme leader.
sentences.zh: 穆什塔巴·哈梅内伊，那位被暗杀的最高领袖的儿子。

sentences.en: And Mushtaba Khamenei is filling a job that is both essential for the regime's survival and arguably now the most dangerous job in the world.
sentences.zh: 穆什塔巴·哈梅内伊所担任的职位，既是政权生存的关键，也可以说是目前世界上最危险的工作。

sentences.en: And we want to talk to you about what his selection means for Iran and the war and the behind-the-scenes process by which he was chosen.
sentences.zh: 我们想和你谈谈他的当选对伊朗和这场战争意味着什么，以及他被选中的幕后过程。

sentences.en: So where do you think we should start?
sentences.zh: 那么，你认为我们应该从哪里开始呢？

sentences.en: I think we should start by acknowledging that Mushtaba Khamenei's rise as the third supreme leader came as a surprise to even Iran watchers and insiders in Iran.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们应该首先承认，穆什塔巴·哈梅内伊作为第三任最高领袖的崛起，即使对伊朗观察家和伊朗内部人士来说也是一个惊喜。

sentences.en: Although he was his father's son and had been working closely with him in his office, the fact that he would become a supreme leader and succeed his father was not straightforward.
sentences.zh: 尽管他是他父亲的儿子，并且一直在办公室与他密切合作，但他将成为最高领袖并继承父亲职位的过程并非顺理成章。

sentences.en: It wasn't necessarily predestined.
sentences.zh: 这并非必然注定。

sentences.en: And it's an irony because the Islamic Revolution came about, so there would be an end to monarchy rule and power being passed from father to son.
sentences.zh: 这很讽刺，因为伊斯兰革命的初衷就是为了终结君主制，终结权力从父传子的模式。

sentences.en: Just explain that.
sentences.zh: 请解释一下这一点。

sentences.en: Well, the Islamic Revolution in 1979 came about as a result of this movement to topple the Shah and thousands of years of monarchy where power was handed from father to son
sentences.zh: 嗯，1979年的伊斯兰革命是推翻沙阿和数千年权力父传子君主制运动的结果，

sentences.en: with this idea that power would go back to the people.
sentences.zh: 其理念是权力应回归人民。

sentences.en: Even when the first supreme leader, the founding father of the revolution, Ayatollah Khomeini, died, power didn't go to his son or to his relatives.
sentences.zh: 即使是革命的开国元勋、第一任最高领袖阿亚图拉·霍梅尼去世时，权力也没有传给他的儿子或亲属。

sentences.en: It went to then the president, the former Ayatollah Khomeini.
sentences.zh: 而是传给了当时的总统，即前任阿亚图拉·霍梅尼。

sentences.en: So that's why it's an irony to now have his son appointed as his successor.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是为什么现在任命他的儿子作为继任者显得如此讽刺。

sentences.en: Fascinating.
sentences.zh: 太引人入胜了。

sentences.en: So the choice of Khomeini's son, Mushtaba Khomeini, you're saying, is in many ways a violation of the revolution's core spirit.
sentences.zh: 所以你说，选择霍梅尼的儿子穆什塔巴·霍梅尼，在许多方面违背了革命的核心精神。

sentences.en: So talk to us about how that ever would have occurred over the past many days.
sentences.zh: 那么请谈谈过去几天里这种情况是如何发生的。

sentences.en: When I talked to sources in Iran about the appointment and selection of Mushtaba Khomeini, they described it as a succession war, as various political factions,
sentences.zh: 当我向伊朗的消息人士询问穆什塔巴·霍梅尼的任命和选拔时，他们将其描述为一场继任战争，各种政治派系、

sentences.en: generals from the Revolutionary Guards, powerful people like the former spy chief of the guards,
sentences.zh: 革命卫队的将军们、像卫队前情报主管那样有权势的人，

sentences.en: guards and clerics, all vying for power to have the candidate that they preferred in the role.
sentences.zh: 以及神职人员，都在争夺权力，试图让自己偏好的候选人担任这一角色。

sentences.en: It was explained to me as sort of the Islamic Republic's version of Game of Thrones, vying for power, different factions, competing to have their favorite candidate in,
sentences.zh: 有人向我解释说，这就像是伊斯兰共和国版的《权力的游戏》，争夺权力，不同派系竞争以让他们最喜欢的候选人上位，

sentences.en: and really a war of succession.
sentences.zh: 这确实是一场继任战争。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Well, describe these main factions in this selection process, who they are and what they want.
sentences.zh: 那么，请描述一下这次选拔过程中的主要派系，他们是谁，想要什么。

sentences.en: So constitutionally in Iran, the Assembly of Experts, which is a body of 88 elected senior clerics, has the task of appointing, supervising, and removing a supreme leader.
sentences.zh: 在伊朗宪法中，专家会议是一个由88名民选高级神职人员组成的机构，负责任命、监督和罢免最高领袖。

sentences.en: So this is the body that had to get together, debate, and vote for who would basically succeed,
sentences.zh: 所以这就是那个必须聚在一起、辩论并投票决定谁将继任的机构，

sentences.en: Ayatollah Khomeini.
sentences.zh: 即阿亚图拉·霍梅尼。

sentences.en: But it's much more complicated than that, right?
sentences.zh: 但这比这复杂得多，对吧？

sentences.en: There's all this, like, backdoor and back-channeling powers and different factions trying to influence the vote of the clerics.
sentences.zh: 这里面有各种幕后交易、后台权力以及试图影响神职人员投票的不同派系。

sentences.en: We had on one side the moderates and the pragmatics, led by the head of the National Security Council, Ali Lairudjani, and President Pezashkian in this camp.
sentences.zh: 我们看到一边是温和派和务实派，由国家安全委员会负责人阿里·拉里贾尼和佩泽什基扬总统领导。

sentences.en: And they were sort of arguing that this is really an extraordinary moment in Iran.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这确实是伊朗的一个非凡时刻。

sentences.en: We're at war with the United States and Israel.
sentences.zh: 我们正在与美国和以色列交战。

sentences.en: We've had months and months of upheaval with protests and whatnot.
sentences.zh: 我们经历了数月的动荡，包括抗议活动等等。

sentences.en: And maybe it's time to put a new face on the regime and pick a candidate that would at least signal to the world and to Iranian public that we're thinking of moderating our
sentences.zh: 也许是时候给政权换个新面孔了，选择一位至少能向世界和伊朗公众发出信号的候选人，表明我们正在考虑缓和我们的

sentences.en: policies or we're thinking of reform.
sentences.zh: 政策，或者我们正在考虑改革。

sentences.en: So basically recognize that the war is a fundamental breaking point.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上是承认这场战争是一个根本性的转折点。

sentences.en: It's a moment from which the country cannot really go back, that a change is required here.
sentences.zh: 这是一个国家无法回头的时刻，这里需要改变。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The war, don't forget, was preceded with massive street uprisings and protests by Iranians saying we want an end of this regime.
sentences.zh: 别忘了，战争之前是伊朗民众大规模的街头起义和抗议，他们说我们想要终结这个政权。

sentences.en: So while they can't really satisfy that desire, I think the moderates were arguing, well, at least maybe this power vacuum we have from the assassination of the Ayatollah
sentences.zh: 所以虽然他们无法真正满足那种愿望，但我认为温和派在争辩说，至少阿亚图拉被暗杀后留下的权力真空，

sentences.en: allows us a space to try to steer the country in a different direction.
sentences.zh: 给了我们一个尝试将国家引向不同方向的空间。

sentences.en: And Farnas, who do these moderates, and I want to be careful with that word, because moderates within a theocracy may not resemble moderates outside of a theocracy,
sentences.zh: 法尔纳兹，这些温和派——我想谨慎使用这个词，因为神职统治下的温和派可能与神职统治之外的温和派不同——

sentences.en: but who do they look to specifically as they try to make this choice?
sentences.zh: 他们在试图做出这个选择时，具体看好谁？

sentences.en: Well, they were looking at several candidates.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们考虑了几位候选人。

sentences.en: One of them was former President Hassan Rouhani.
sentences.zh: 其中之一是前总统哈桑·鲁哈尼。

sentences.en: He's mostly a centrist politician who served eight years as president and before that had very senior leadership roles in security apparatus.
sentences.zh: 他主要是一位中间派政治家，担任过八年总统，在此之前在安全机构中担任过非常高级的领导职务。

sentences.en: He led the 2015 negotiations, nuclear negotiations with the United States and world powers.
sentences.zh: 他领导了2015年与美国和世界大国的核谈判。

sentences.en: And he's increasingly become vocal in giving speeches about how the status quo was not tenable.
sentences.zh: 他越来越直言不讳地发表演讲，称现状是不可持续的。

sentences.en: So the second candidate was Hassan Khomeini, the grandson of the founding father of the revolution, who is squarely identified his politics as reformist and he's part of the
sentences.zh: 第二位候选人是哈桑·霍梅尼，革命开国元勋的孙子，他的政治立场明确被认定为改革派，他是

sentences.en: reformist faction.
sentences.zh: 改革派的一员。

sentences.en: And then there was a third candidate who is not very well known in the public, Ali Reza Arafi.
sentences.zh: 还有第三位候选人，公众不太熟悉，阿里·礼萨·阿拉菲。

sentences.en: He has religious credentials.
sentences.zh: 他有宗教背景。

sentences.en: He ran a very successful charity, a religious charity.
sentences.zh: 他经营着一家非常成功的慈善机构，一家宗教慈善机构。

sentences.en: And he was sort of considered as someone who would be easy to manage because he didn't really
sentences.zh: 他被认为是一个容易管理的人，因为他并没有真正

sentences.en: have experience in security or policy or defense and sort of would fall somewhere in the middle.
sentences.zh: 在安全、政策或国防方面的经验，而且处于中间地带。

sentences.en: So all three of these say to the world, to varying degrees, turn the page on the revolutionary hardline Iranian ethos that has dominated since 1979.
sentences.zh: 所以这三个人都在不同程度上向世界传达了一个信息：翻开自1979年以来一直主导伊朗的革命强硬派精神的新篇章。

sentences.en: That was basically the idea.
sentences.zh: 这基本上就是那个想法。

sentences.en: Now, with the caveat, as you mentioned, that these are all still part of the Islamic Republic's establishment.
sentences.zh: 当然，正如你提到的，有一个前提，那就是他们仍然是伊斯兰共和国体制的一部分。

sentences.en: And they are loyal to the ideology of the Islamic Republic, but they have varying shades of how to pragmatically and practically practice that and enforce it.
sentences.zh: 他们忠于伊斯兰共和国的意识形态，但对于如何务实和实际地实践及执行这种意识形态，他们有不同的理解。

sentences.en: And I think if they had gone this way, they would have at least signaled that maybe we're open to change.
sentences.zh: 我认为如果他们选择了这条路，至少会发出一个信号，表明我们可能对改变持开放态度。

sentences.en: Maybe we're even open to scaling down hostilities with the United States.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能对降低与美国的敌对状态持开放态度。

sentences.en: But that's not how it went.
sentences.zh: 但事情并没有那样发展。

sentences.en: Clearly.
sentences.zh: 很明显。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Well, what about the hardline faction?
sentences.zh: 那么强硬派呢？

sentences.en: So the hardline faction, particularly the Revolutionary Guards Corps, they were interested
sentences.zh: 强硬派，特别是革命卫队，他们感兴趣的是

sentences.en: in making sure that, first of all, at wartime, there would be no concessions made, no surrendering to U.S.
sentences.zh: 确保在战时不会做出任何让步，不会向美国的要求投降，

sentences.en: demands, that sort of the policies and strategies that the Ayatollah and the Guards had defined would hold as the war continued.
sentences.zh: 确保阿亚图拉和卫队所定义的政策和战略在战争继续期间能够保持不变。

sentences.en: The Revolutionary Guards are very powerful in Iran.
sentences.zh: 革命卫队在伊朗非常强大。

sentences.en: They're represented in politics.
sentences.zh: 他们在政界有代表。

sentences.en: They control the economy.
sentences.zh: 他们控制着经济。

sentences.en: They are more powerful than the military, the army itself.
sentences.zh: 他们比军队本身更强大。

sentences.en: And they're now in charge of basically commanding this war because they're in charge of defending
sentences.zh: 他们现在基本上负责指挥这场战争，因为他们负责保卫

sentences.en: Iran's borders.
sentences.zh: 伊朗的边界。

sentences.en: So for the Guards, the election or the appointment of the supreme leader was also an existential
sentences.zh: 所以对卫队来说，最高领袖的选举或任命也是一个生存

sentences.en: choice because they wanted to make sure that their power and their grip on power remains.
sentences.zh: 选择，因为他们想确保他们的权力和对权力的掌控保持不变。

sentences.en: And who is in this hardline faction's pool of candidates for supreme leader?
sentences.zh: 那么强硬派的最高领袖候选人池里都有谁？

sentences.en: This pool wanted Moshabba Khamenei.
sentences.zh: 这个群体想要穆什塔巴·哈梅内伊。

sentences.en: Unanimously, he was the candidate of choice.
sentences.zh: 他是一致公认的候选人。

sentences.en: They viewed him as a very close ally, as a reincarnation, if you may, of Ayatollah Khamenei,
sentences.zh: 他们视他为非常亲密的盟友，如果可以的话，视他为阿亚图拉·哈梅内伊的转世，

sentences.en: who would continue his policies and give the Guards a free hand, particularly in running this war.
sentences.zh: 他将延续他的政策，并给卫队以自由裁量权，特别是在进行这场战争方面。

sentences.en: And to this end, they were willing to toss out this whole idea of power should not be hereditary in the Islamic Republic.
sentences.zh: 为此，他们愿意抛弃伊斯兰共和国权力不应世袭的整个理念。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有趣。

sentences.en: They just sort of said, that's a formality we don't care about in the middle of this conflict.
sentences.zh: 他们只是说，这是一种我们在冲突中不在乎的形式。

sentences.en: Who cares?
sentences.zh: 谁在乎呢？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, they basically said, this is wartime, the circumstances are extreme, and our former supreme leader, they consider him a martyr.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们基本上说，这是战时，情况极端，而我们的前任最高领袖，他们认为他是烈士。

sentences.en: And a lot of the anger and resentment against President Trump and Prime Minister Netanyahu was being fueled into this sense of defiance, right?
sentences.zh: 而且对特朗普总统和内塔尼亚胡总理的许多愤怒和怨恨，都被转化为这种反抗感，对吧？

sentences.en: A lot of experts I talked to in Iran and outside of Iran said that, look, if Khamenei had died a natural death, Moshaba would have a lot of resistance.
sentences.zh: 我在伊朗内外采访的许多专家都说，看，如果哈梅内伊是自然死亡，穆什塔巴会面临很多阻力。

sentences.en: But now the Guards and the hardliners could argue that, look, you know, they martyred our supreme leader.
sentences.zh: 但现在卫队和强硬派可以争辩说，看，你知道，他们杀害了我们的最高领袖。

sentences.en: And who is the closest thing we can get to him?
sentences.zh: 我们能找到的最接近他的人是谁？

sentences.en: His son, who not only physically looks like him, but also worked in his office and as far as we know, has the same ideological beliefs and policies.
sentences.zh: 他的儿子，不仅外表像他，而且在他的办公室工作，据我们所知，拥有相同的意识形态信仰和政策。

sentences.en: Okay, so with all this in mind, how does the formal process of choosing Moshaba Khamenei ultimately unfold?
sentences.zh: 好的，考虑到所有这些，选择穆什塔巴·哈梅内伊的正式过程最终是如何展开的？

sentences.en: You describe it as filled with intrigue and drama, Game of Thrones.
sentences.zh: 你将其描述为充满阴谋和戏剧性，就像《权力的游戏》一样。

sentences.en: What does it look like?
sentences.zh: 它看起来是什么样的？

sentences.en: The process of selecting the supreme leader began almost immediately after Ayatollah Khamenei was killed in airstrikes on the first day of the war.
